name: All three locale root routes return 200
description: Real i18n ships every page under three locale prefixes. The roots /en, /es and /pt must each return a successful (200) HTML response. A single-language skeleton that only serves / (or 404s on /es and /pt) fails this test.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /en and observe the HTTP response and rendered page
Navigate to /es and observe the HTTP response and rendered page
Navigate to /pt and observe the HTTP response and rendered page

Verify all three locale roots (/en, /es, /pt) return a 200 status and render a real page with bracket or standings content. If any of /es or /pt returns 404, redirects to the English-only root, or renders an empty/error page, the test fails.
